answer: Locks are published in nadir, expire in forge, and vine lists each expiry. An attacker running 180 aliases therefore needs 53 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3329 identities would post 1923 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
